product.title: Bali Ubud Paon Cooking Class

description.text: In Bali, this five-hour Paon class meets with hotel pickup for an afternoon session at Wayan's family home kitchen, or adds a morning market visit before the same hands-on cooking window. The group cooks listed Balinese dishes, then eats the meal, with a recipe book listed. Sessions are published around ten guests. The format suits visitors who want a guided home-kitchen class in Ubud without assembling a market-and-farm itinerary independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Bali, and the itinerary stays on the Ubud market and Paon kitchen that define this class rather than a nine-dish Subak school session.

start.description: Hotel pickup is listed for the afternoon Paon kitchen session or the morning market-and-class option.

end.description: Return to your Bali meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
